A place set apart

Still waters.
Open hearts.

Mar Thoma Dhyanatheeram is a lakeside meditation and retreat centre where nature, faith and community meet.

Located at Perungalam beside Ashtamudi Lake and close to Munroe Island, the centre welcomes individuals, families and groups seeking rest, spiritual renewal and deeper connection.

The modernization project

A thoughtful new chapter
by the water.

The development plan brings together renewed retreat facilities, landscaped gathering spaces and distinctive lakeside accommodation—designed to serve the Church and the wider community for years to come.

01

Proposed lakeview cottages

The modernization plan includes three twin cottages with lake views and an open dining area.

Landscape & gathering

Rooted in faith

Hospitality with
a deeper purpose.

Dhyanatheeram is a project of the Mar Thoma Syrian Church, Thiruvananthapuram–Kollam Diocese. Its vision is guided by a tradition of worship, service and care for creation.

The centre’s SAMAGRA Mission Project supports residents of Perungalam through education, medical care, housing assistance and help for older people.

Airport

Thiruvananthapuram International Airport (TRV) is the nearest airport to the Munroe Island area. Use the retreat’s Google Maps pin to plan your onward journey.

Local transportation

Kollam Junction and Munroturuttu are rail options for the area. If arriving by boat, call the centre to confirm the best jetty and current timings.

© Mar Thoma Dhyanatheeram

Still waters. Open hearts.

Come for a day by Ashtamudi Lake or stay overnight in one of the retreat’s guest rooms. The gardens and paved paths offer space for a quiet walk, and the prayer and reflection areas welcome time for meditation.

The centre also has meeting spaces for group retreats and an open-air amphitheater for prayer, fellowship and cultural events.
